items.name: ai-provider-card
items.title: AI Provider Card
items.description: A small card for one AI provider in an overview grid, whose status tones its footer note and whose covering trigger selects it.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: One chat message row over upstream Message, with a line beside its leading edge while its text is still streaming.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Read-only source over a collapsible card, highlighted through the shared Shiki highlighter and falling back to plain mono while the grammar loads.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: The composable parts of a @tanstack/react-table view - toolbar, view, column header actions, pagination and view options - reading one shared table instance from context.

items.name: file-type-icon
items.title: File Type Icon
items.description: A lucide icon chosen for a file's type from its extension, decorative unless paired with the visible file name or given an aria-label.

items.name: font-preview
items.title: Font Preview
items.description: A specimen of a font file at several sizes, one row per size, loaded through an @font-face scoped to the instance.

items.name: highlighted-code
items.title: Highlighted Code
items.description: A mono code element that renders tokenized lines from the shared Shiki highlighter, falling back to its raw children until they arrive.

items.name: image-preview
items.title: Image Preview
items.description: Shows an image contained within its filled wrapper, over a checkerboard so transparent pixels read clearly.

items.name: markdown-view
items.title: Markdown View
items.description: Renders a GitHub-Flavored Markdown string styled to the design tokens, with tables as the upstream Table and fenced code optionally rendered as a CodeBlock instead of a plain pre.

items.name: model-info-card
items.title: Model Info Card
items.description: The detail panel for one model: an identity header composed from Item parts over titled sections.

items.name: chat-suggestion-item
items.title: Chat Suggestion Item
items.description: One starter prompt in an empty conversation, an upstream Item rendered as a button that hands its prompt to onSelectPrompt when picked.

items.name: emoji-appearance-toggle-group
items.title: Emoji Appearance Toggle Group
items.description: A single-select row of swatches for choosing the Fluent Emoji artwork style, each previewing the same sample emoji in its own style.

items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: A searchable, categorized emoji grid with an optional frequent row and a category nav, windowed so opening the catalog renders only what is in view.

items.name: language-combobox
items.title: Language Combobox
items.description: A searchable language picker over upstream Combobox that maps a BCP-47 code or code-language id to its option and reports the value the consumer picks.

items.name: language-toggle-group
items.title: Language Toggle Group
items.description: Every language shown inline as a single-select toggle group for a small fixed set, which never deselects so a language is always chosen.

items.name: number-field
items.title: Number Field
items.description: A compact numeric field for a property inspector that parses arithmetic expressions, clamps to min and max, and steps on the arrow keys.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: A password field with a show or hide toggle packaged into the addon, so a call site never wires the eye button itself.

items.name: resize-handle
items.title: Resize Handle
items.description: A vertical resize grip for a side or floating panel that only starts dragging once the pointer crosses a small movement threshold.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: A tag editor with removable chips above an input that commits a new tag on Enter, comma, or blur.

items.name: tree-item
items.title: Tree Item
items.description: One row of a hierarchy tree over upstream Item, with a depth indent and disclosure, a clickable label and an inline rename input.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: An icon button that copies its value to the clipboard, showing a check and carrying data-copied until its timeout resets it.

items.name: permission-card
items.title: Permission Card
items.description: An inline, non-modal AI-consent request that stays in scrollback after it resolves, switching between its decision and resolved parts as the host settles its status.

items.name: status-indicator
items.title: Status Indicator
items.description: A small decorative dot colored by a semantic status tone (online, offline, busy or idle), which can pulse for a state still in progress.

items.name: unsaved-indicator
items.title: Unsaved Indicator
items.description: The unsaved-changes dot an editor shows on a tab, announced as an image named Unsaved changes.

items.name: icon-media
items.title: Icon Media
items.description: A small square that holds one glyph, tinted through the caller's className.

items.name: icon-label
items.title: Icon Label
items.description: A label whose icon stands in for a field's text in a dense panel, tied to its control through htmlFor and sizing an unclassed child svg to a compact glyph.

items.name: avatar-picker
items.title: Avatar Picker
items.description: A Popover-based avatar editor whose emoji, upload and color panes edit one avatar value.

items.name: center
items.title: Center
items.description: A box that centers its children on both axes, in block or inline flow, with its element swappable through render.

items.name: collapsible-card
items.title: Collapsible Card
items.description: A collapsible card with a header and body, open by default, on a card, muted or plain surface.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: An accessible file tree that drives keyboard navigation and owns selection and folder expansion, controlled or uncontrolled.

items.name: floating-toolbar
items.title: Floating Toolbar
items.description: A floating, blurred card-color toolbar shell, a toolbar landmark around the tools the caller composes.

items.name: frontmatter-form
items.title: Frontmatter Form
items.description: A frontmatter editor whose root holds the document and field setters for the consumer's composed fields.

items.name: model-list
items.title: Model List
items.description: The frame for a model list section: a header over a scrolling content area that dims any item marked unavailable.

items.name: page-container
items.title: Page Container
items.description: The centered, max-width content column of a full-width surface, sized from a named max-width scale.

items.name: panel-field-group
items.title: Panel Field Group
items.description: The tight grid for paired and triplet inputs in a property panel, with any number of columns.

items.name: panel-header
items.title: Panel Header
items.description: The top strip of a side panel: one or more rows of a title and trailing actions over a bottom border.

items.name: panel-row
items.title: Panel Row
items.description: One row of a property section, its fields beside a trailing action column that keeps every row's right edge aligned.

items.name: reasoning-collapsible
items.title: Reasoning Collapsible
items.description: A thinking disclosure that opens itself while a reasoning stream is live and closes shortly after the stream ends.

items.name: tool-call-card
items.title: Tool Call Card
items.description: One tool invocation in a chat transcript: a trigger row over collapsible sections, whose status badge follows the call's lifecycle state.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: A command palette for jumping to a target: a controlled CommandDialog holding a Command that reports the chosen item's value and closes on select.

items.name: editor-tab
items.title: Editor Tab
items.description: One tab in an editor's tab strip, whose close button shows the unsaved dot until the tab's hover, focus or active state reveals its X.

items.name: ai-provider-picker
items.title: AI Provider Picker
items.description: A responsive grid of AI provider cards, from the host's entries or a sample, that calls back with the provider key a card selects.
